library: Patrick Apple Watch Modular Style Library
rootContract: All generated work is contained below this manifest's directory.

reference.usage: Morphology/context reference only; generated assets are independent redraws.

optimization.sourceTier: 1024×1024 RGBA PNG for review, re-export, and future vector/paint replacement
optimization.shippingGuidance: Ship only selected family/state combinations; keep assets-src and previews outside the watch app bundle.
optimization.recommendedFuture: Use indexed PNG where alpha permits; validate ASTC/asset-catalog output on device.

families.name: Clean 1999 broadcast cel
families.construction: Uneven single-pass cel contour with flat hand-painted fills.
families.edge: Firm ink edge, tiny registration wobble, no digital smoothing aesthetic.
families.material: Opaque cel paint with restrained two-tone spot accents.

families.name: B/W animation model sheet
families.construction: Redrawn graphite/ink contour with visible searching strokes.
families.edge: Double-line corrections, broken construction arcs, variable pressure.
families.material: Strict black, white, and neutral gray animation-paper logic.

families.name: Expressive pen-line illustration
families.construction: Loose nib redraw with elastic curves and deliberate overshoot.
families.edge: Dry pen skips, parallel contour searching, directional hatching.
families.material: Transparent watercolor-like fill under warm brown pen.

families.name: Chinese ink-wash 水墨
families.construction: Shape rebuilt as overlapping wet washes and calligraphic strokes.
families.edge: Feathered ink diffusion, broken dry-brush perimeter, lost-and-found contour.
families.material: Translucent carbon wash with restrained cinnabar and moss accents.

families.name: Vintage woodcut / risograph
families.construction: Angular block-cut silhouette with independently registered plates.
families.edge: Coarse carved contour, teal misregistration, clipped hatch channels.
families.material: Two-ink riso overprint, visible halftone and carved negative marks.

families.name: Faithful non-cute clay 3D
families.construction: Re-sculpted pear volume with small face and long un-cute taper.
families.edge: Soft occlusion edge, asymmetric compression, modeled seam at sockets.
families.material: Layered clay shading, finger dents, matte roughness, no toy gloss.
